# Streamline Digital Solutions

> The Ecommerce Growth Engine. We build, market, and automate online stores for scaling brands worldwide. Cape Town based, operating globally.

## Summary
Streamline Digital Solutions is an AI-native ecommerce growth agency founded in Cape Town, South Africa. The agency provides end-to-end digital services for high-growth online stores and direct-to-consumer (DTC) brands, specializing in headless ecommerce development, technical SEO, paid customer acquisition (Meta and Google Ads), lifecycle marketing, custom automation pipelines, and autonomous AI agents.

## Core Services
- **Web Design & Development**: Custom Shopify, Liquid, Next.js, and WooCommerce builds with 99+ Core Web Vitals, conversion-rate-optimized UX, and modular architectures.
- **Search Engine Optimization (SEO)**: Technical SEO, programmatic page architecture, search intent modeling, CRO, and revenue-driven organic rankings.
- **Paid Advertising**: Meta Ads and Google Ads management with full-funnel creative testing, proprietary attribution modeling, and ROAS scaling frameworks.
- **Mobile App Development**: React Native and Expo cross-platform mobile commerce applications with push notification retention engines.
- **CRM & Lifecycle Marketing**: Klaviyo, Omnisend, customer segmentation, automated lifecycle email/SMS flows, and repeat purchase optimization.
- **Workflow Automations**: Custom backend automation pipelines using n8n, Make, webhooks, and REST APIs to eliminate manual operational bottlenecks.
- **AI Solutions & Autonomous Workflows**: Custom AI agents, intelligent customer support pipelines, automated inventory monitors, and margin preservation engines.

## Case Studies
- [Futurama](https://streamlinedigitalsolutions.com/work/futurama): Outdoor, optics, and tactical ecommerce store scaling revenue and performance with headless Shopify.
- [Camping Fridge SA](https://streamlinedigitalsolutions.com/work/camping-fridge): High-ticket outdoor equipment digital store overhaul, custom search architecture, and 3.4x ROAS.
- [MyMini](https://streamlinedigitalsolutions.com/work/mymini): Lifestyle ecommerce brand growth, conversion rate optimization, and rapid acquisition scaling.
- [Graft Hybrid Training](https://streamlinedigitalsolutions.com/work/graft-hybrid-training): Fitness apparel and training equipment online platform with custom loyalty integration.
- [Wild Clone](https://streamlinedigitalsolutions.com/work/wild-clone): DTC botanical brand scaling through full-funnel performance marketing.

## Thought Leadership & Guides
- [Headless Shopify vs Liquid Architecture](https://streamlinedigitalsolutions.com/blog/headless-shopify-vs-liquid-architecture): Engineering guide on when high-volume stores should transition to headless versus optimized Liquid.
- [Ecommerce Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Playbook](https://streamlinedigitalsolutions.com/blog/ecommerce-conversion-rate-optimization-playbook): 14 tested psychological and technical principles for boosting checkout velocity.
- [AI Autonomous Workflows for Modern Ecommerce](https://streamlinedigitalsolutions.com/blog/ai-autonomous-workflows-for-ecommerce): Blueprint for deploying LLMs and agentic automations in operations and support.
